name: The Little Nell
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out hotel at the base of Aspen Mountain and at the center of town, steps from the Silver Queen Gondola
best_for: Skiers who want to step from the hotel onto Aspen Mountain
Travelers who want winter and summer mountain experiences arranged by the hotel
Families wanting cribs, strollers and in-room extras

facts.text: The hotel sits at the base of Aspen Mountain and at the center of town.
Guests wake up steps from the Silver Queen Gondola.
Boots are heated overnight and gear is stored in the Ski Concierge room, whose doors open right onto the mountain.
The hotel runs a complimentary shuttle to Snowmass, Buttermilk and Aspen Highlands.
Hotel experiences run from Snowcat Powder Tours in winter to Fly Fishing and Off-Road Tours in summer.
The Audi Experience, a test drive of an electric Audi Q6 e-tron or Audi Q7, is complimentary for hotel guests.
The hotel has a heated outdoor pool, hot tubs and saunas.
Mountain Side rooms have balconies with views of the hotel courtyard or the mountain.
The Residences at The Little Nell have their own dedicated rooftop pools.
The wine cellar holds over 20,000 bottles.
Cribs, strollers and PlayStations can be delivered to the room.

highlights.text: First Tracks lets skiers and riders make turns on top-to-bottom runs before Aspen Mountain officially opens to the public.
The Little Nell Suite has wall-to-wall windows and two wrap-around balconies with views of Aspen Mountain.
The Roch Suite is inspired by Andre Roch, the Swiss mountaineer who planned and surveyed Aspen Mountain.
The hotel was built on the site of Aspen's original silver mine.
Element 47 has held the Wine Spectator Grand Award for 29 consecutive years since 1997.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel's spa as small.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive Aspen location.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The Little Nell
